attempts.summary: Configured persistent internal DNS resolution. node1 runs dnsmasq on 10.100.255.10 and resolves inventory-api.internal to node2 at 10.100.255.11. node2 persistently prefers node1 as its resolver. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities. Ubuntu 16.04.7 and kernel 4.4.0-210 were retained.
